legal.privacy:
Family Folder does not collect information about you or send it anywhere. The app has no server of its own, no accounts, no ads and no analytics.
• The microphone starts with Record and stops on Stop, Cancel or leaving the chat. You can listen before sending; recordings are sent only with Send, to the chosen person or family. History and voice recordings are stored in the app data folder, separate from shared files, and recordings are not uploaded to cloud storage. Papych does not change the recorded voice.
• Files travel directly between your family's computers over an encrypted connection (QUIC and TLS 1.3).
• To find each other, computers use public servers of the iroh project (n0). If a direct connection isn't possible, data goes through their relays. These servers see the device key, IP address and an encrypted stream, but not the contents of files.
• A cloud is connected only if you choose to, and it uses your own account. Files are encrypted on the computer with the family key before upload and removed from the cloud once received. Cloud sign-in details are stored on your family's computers and shared only between them.
• Settings, keys and the activity log are stored only on your computer, in %APPDATA%\ObshayaPapka.
When uninstalled, the app removes its shortcuts and menu items; files in the family folder stay.
legal.terms:
The app is free and provided “as is”, without any warranty.

• You are responsible for what you share and for respecting the law and other people's rights, including copyright.
• Don't keep important files in a single copy — make backups.
• Third-party services (iroh servers, Yandex Disk, WebDAV servers, cloud drives) follow their own rules; the developer is not responsible for them.
By using the app, you agree to these terms.

tour.hello.title: Hi! I’m Papych
tour.hello.text: I live in Family Folder and help you send files to your family. Let me show you what I can do!
tour.island.title: My bar lives right here
tour.island.text: Move the pointer to the very top centre of the screen — I’ll peek out and show who’s online and how downloads are going. New files and messages arrive here too.
tour.drag.title: Drag files up here
tour.drag.text: Grab a file and drag it to the top of the screen — the bar opens up. Drop it on me and everyone gets it; drop it on a family robot and only that device does.
tour.window.title: In the app window too
tour.window.text: You can drop files right onto the window — I’ll swallow them and send them off. And when you press “Get”, I jump onto the button myself.
tour.messages.title: Chats
tour.messages.text: Open “Chats” and choose a person or the whole family. Send text, links and voice: record with the microphone button, then listen, cancel or send. Papych comes alive while recording and playing.
tour.tray.title: I’m always by the clock
tour.tray.text: The app runs in the background — my icon is here by the clock. Slowing your internet? Pause me and I’ll nap in my nightcap.
tour.pet.title: You can pet me
tour.pet.text: Click me and I’ll be happy. Just don’t click too often: I’ll sneeze, and then my head will spin!
tour.bye.title: That’s it!
tour.bye.text: Heading back into the window. If you forget anything, the tour is in Settings → “Papych”.
